The six .jpeg files in this folder are tiles of basemap.at's orthophoto,
"Datenquelle: basemap.at" (https://basemap.at), under the Creative Commons
licence CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. They are
not covered by the licence of the code around them.

Each was recorded on 2026-11-20 between 21:55 and 21:58 UTC with one GET
of

    https://mapsneu.wien.gv.at/basemap/bmaporthofoto30cm/normal/google3857/{z}/{y}/{x}.jpeg

with a generic User-Agent, and is kept as it came. The file name is
<where>_<z>_<x>_<y>.jpeg:

    inside_innsbruck_15_17420_11489     Innsbruck, wholly inside Austria
    outside_munich_10_544_355           Munich and its surroundings: all
                                        white, 2419 bytes, byte for byte
                                        the tile over Bolzano at zoom 10
    border_achenpass_12_2181_1430       the Bavarian border at the Achenpass
    border_achenpass_15_17448_11446     the same, finer
    border_achenpass_19_279183_183141   the same, at the finest zoom: all
                                        photograph, inside Austria but
                                        within 50 m of the border
    border_brenner_15_17431_11524       the Italian border at the Brenner

What the service answered on the same evening, beside these: the tile over
Munich at zoom 12 (12/2179/1421) was a 404 of 146 bytes, not a white
tile, although it lies inside the service's box; so was the one at zoom
14. White tiles beyond the border are there at some zooms and places and
missing at others. And at the Achenpass and the Brenner the photograph
itself reaches beyond the border, up to about a kilometre at zoom 12: the
white begins further out. tests/golden/summary.txt counts what the cut
removes of it.

To record them again: fetch the addresses above (z, then y, then x),
then run the tests with VENTI_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 and look at the PNGs in
tests/golden before accepting them.
